rawFindings.title: Possible TypeError when slug is a number in Post.prototype.create
rawFindings.explanation: Changed code uses `data.slug || data.title` directly as argument to `slugize` without toString conversion. If `data.slug` or `data.title` is a number (non-string), slugize may throw or behave unexpectedly since it expects a string.
rawFindings.suggestion: Convert `data.slug || data.title` to string before passing to `slugize`, e.g. `(data.slug || data.title).toString()` as was done previously.

rawFindings.title: Possible TypeError when slug is a number in Post.prototype.publish
rawFindings.explanation: Changed code uses `data.slug` directly as argument to `slugize` without toString conversion. If `data.slug` is a number, `slugize` may throw or misbehave.
rawFindings.suggestion: Convert `data.slug` to string before passing to `slugize`, e.g. `slugize(data.slug.toString(), {transform: config.filename_case})` as was done previously.
